show.name: The Upshaws
show.summary: The Upshaws centers on a working-class African American family in Indiana struggling to make it work and make it right without the blueprints to do it.

episodes.name: Birthday B.S.
episodes.summary: When two of his kids have birthday parties on the same day, Bennie scrambles to find a venue for one, then bounces back and forth between both events.

episodes.name: The Hook-Up
episodes.summary: After meeting the manager of an upscale restaurant, Bennie takes Regina out hoping to break their dry spell but realizes the meal isn't on the house.

episodes.name: Joy Ride
episodes.summary: A customer entrusts his sleek ride with its secret compartment to Bennie. Duck overstays his welcome at the Upshaw residence. Regina eyes a promotion.

episodes.name: Big Plans
episodes.summary: As Regina tries to land a better job at a different organization, Bennie's friends get in his ear about her looking to level up her life without him.

episodes.name: Ridin' Dirty
episodes.summary: Regina juggles family duties with work and studying for the GMAT, but Bennie doesn't help lighten the load — and she reaches a boiling point.

episodes.name: Last Straw
episodes.summary: When Tasha gets into an accident, Bennie comes up with a solution — without telling Regina. Meanwhile, conflicts erupt between other family members.

episodes.name: Yard Sale
episodes.summary: After Regina throws Bennie out, she starts cleaning house. Bennie tries his old tricks to get back in her good graces. Lucretia's affair takes a turn.

episodes.name: Night Out
episodes.summary: Regina goes to her work party solo while Bennie has his own fun with the guys. Lucretia and Bennie get drunk together, and Bernard reveals his truth.

episodes.name: Gloves Off
episodes.summary: When Bennie tries to live a healthier lifestyle, he winds up in a boxing ring with an emotional Bernard. Maya struggles with a school bully.

episodes.name: The Backslide
episodes.summary: With Bennie back in the house and bonding more with the kids, Regina's frustrations start to show. After she takes the GMAT, the family comes together.

episodes.name: Maybe Daddy
episodes.summary: When a surprise comes knocking on the family's front door, Regina points the finger at Bennie and pushes Bernard to wise up.

episodes.name: Bennie's Woman
episodes.summary: A suspicious Lucretia conducts a thorough investigation. Meanwhile, a big misunderstanding leads to a bigger mistake as Bennie attempts to close a deal.

episodes.name: Testing, Testing
episodes.summary: When Regina retakes the GMAT, Lucretia struggles to keep order in the house. Bennie and the crew scramble to get the shop up to code for an inspection.

episodes.name: Control Issues
episodes.summary: Regina is determined to throw a budget-friendly birthday party for Maya until Lucretia takes over. Bennie tries to bribe his way out of a lawsuit.

episodes.name: Duct Up
episodes.summary: Regina plots to win over her boss at work. Lucretia dines with an old flame. Bennie lands in a tight spot. The kids are left to look after themselves.

episodes.name: New Growth
episodes.summary: A crisis forces Regina to seek out Tasha's services. At the shop, Lucretia tries to talk sense into Bennie. Aaliyah and Maya have a sibling squabble.

episodes.name: Sista, Sista
episodes.summary: With their unfiltered sister in town, Lucretia and Regina let a few things off their chests. Not to be outdone by Noah, Bennie makes a pricey purchase.

episodes.name: Goin' In
episodes.summary: After their blowout, Lucretia takes time for herself while Regina gets fed up at work. Bennie fears he's losing Kelvin. All drama leads back to the shop.

episodes.name: The Unforgiven
episodes.summary: With Bennie and Lucretia in a pinch, a jobless Regina must drum up cash fast — and try to hide the situation from the kids.

episodes.name: Home Repairs
episodes.summary: Frustrated with his job at the garage, Bennie starts a new business closer to home. Aaliyah yearns to fit in. Bernard's relationship hits a bump.

episodes.name: Treading Water
episodes.summary: After running into a roadblock on her job search, Regina takes advantage of funemployment. Bennie gets a fancy new gig, and Aaliyah seeks a new friend.

episodes.name: Off Beat
episodes.summary: In need of a break, Regina crashes Lucretia's homecoming weekend. Bernard attempts to connect with his daughter. Aaliyah deals with a friendship breakup.

episodes.name: Lane Change
episodes.summary: Regina makes adjustments at her new job. Aaliyah believes Maya is possessed and sets out to film her. Kelvin's return causes friction among the family.

episodes.name: Heart Wants
episodes.summary: After having a strange dream, Regina thinks of what could have been. Lucretia receives a tempting offer. Bennie's back issues cause problems at the shop.

episodes.name: Heart Matters
episodes.summary: An unexpected crisis puts the family on edge and forces Regina to take a pause. Meanwhile, Lucretia and Bennie handle responsibilities at home.

episodes.name: Now What
episodes.summary: The family sends Regina off as she takes on a new endeavor, but a sudden change of plans has Lucretia and Bennie worried about her — and the future.

episodes.name: Thera Please
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of her heart attack, Regina attempts to bring Bennie to therapy with her. An overwhelmed Lucretia starts to miss having her own space.

episodes.name: Need Change
episodes.summary: Lucretia receives life-changing news after agreeing to fund Bernard's business. When therapy with Bennie uncovers hard truths, Regina has a breakthrough.

episodes.name: Forbidden Fruit
episodes.summary: A hot-headed Bernard teaches Aaliyah how to drive. Regina and Bennie find new thrills in sneaky rendezvous. Lucretia tries to resell gifts for money.

episodes.name: Slap Happy
episodes.summary: Aaliyah continues to shun Regina. A turn of events gives Lucretia cause for celebration, but not for long. Bennie acts fast when Kelvin lands in trouble.

episodes.name: Really, Mama?
episodes.summary: A surprise visitor puts Bennie's loyalties to the test. Lucretia secures a new source of income that makes her circumstances more challenging.

episodes.name: Auto Motives
episodes.summary: Now flush with cash, Bennie splurges on a gift for the kids that stirs up tension with Bernard. At a crossroads, Lucretia weighs a difficult decision.

episodes.name: Hail Mary
episodes.summary: With the shop and their finances in jeopardy, Bennie and Lucretia search high and low for a solution and potential buyer. Is the family business a wrap?

episodes.name: Electric Feels
episodes.summary: The family adjusts to their new living situation. Bennie works to get his electric vehicle certification. Aaliyah tries to keep her boyfriend a secret.

episodes.name: Background Checkered
episodes.summary: Bennie meddles in Aaliyah's relationship, sparking memories of him meeting Regina's parents. Maya's school play about Black history riles Lucretia up.

episodes.name: Girl Trouble
episodes.summary: Regina attempts to make good with an old rival for Aaliyah's sake. A heartbroken Tony seeks help from Bennie as he steps back into the dating scene.

episodes.name: Ain't Broke
episodes.summary: Lucretia takes a big leap — but Regina worries her sister's making a big decision for the wrong reasons. Bennie pushes a nervous Bernard to open his gym.

episodes.name: Do I?
episodes.summary: Regina and Bennie are forced to help a newly single Tasha get back on her feet. Major doubts linger for Lucretia and Frank as the big day approaches.

episodes.name: Gone, But...
episodes.summary: Regina misses her sister but makes a new bestie — much to Aaliyah's annoyance. In Atlanta, Lucretia worries about fitting in with Frank's rich friends.

episodes.name: She's Back
episodes.summary: Bennie and Regina get a surprise when they pick up Maya from school. A salary dispute stirs trouble at the garage, threatening to derail Regina's plans.

episodes.name: Running Numbers
episodes.summary: Regina's annoyed when Lucretia undermines her vision for the clinic. Bennie gets an idea to make money after taking Maya and Sydney to their soccer game.

episodes.name: Hold Up
episodes.summary: Bennie's blabbermouth puts Regina in a dangerous situation. Lucretia's feelings are hurt when she takes Aaliyah to tour a prospective college.

episodes.name: Grifter, Grifter
episodes.summary: Everyone's on guard when Glodine drops in on the Upshaws — with big news. Bernard tests the dating waters, but things don't go quite as he planned.

episodes.name: Who, Me?
episodes.summary: After a window at Bernard's gym gets broken, a guilt-stricken Bennie tries to piece together his wild night. Lucretia and Frank go apartment shopping.

episodes.name: Tee'd Off
episodes.summary: While Lucretia gets busy with renovations, Frank and Bennie attempt to bond over golf. Aaliyah goes through a bad-boy phase, testing Regina's patience.

episodes.name: & Son
episodes.summary: When the garage gets busy, Bennie takes a chance and gives Kelvin a job. Althea and Regina try to persuade Lucretia to make up with Frank.

episodes.name: Lost Causes
episodes.summary: A drastic decision puts Maya and Aaliyah on their best behavior. Tasha joins in the search for Kelvin. Bernard and Regina take on city hall.

episodes.name: Buy Now
episodes.summary: Bernard and Aaliyah help Regina make a list of things that could hurt her run for city council. Bennie takes out a loan to get Lucretia off his back.

episodes.name: The Black-Lash
episodes.summary: After running into red tape, Bennie hustles to keep the garage afloat. Regina scrambles to spin a past mistake that could blow up her campaign.

episodes.name: Save Face
episodes.summary: As the race heats up, Lucretia pushes Regina to fight dirty. Bernard juggles work and parenting. Bennie and the crew hit the road to restock their stash.

episodes.name: Gone Awry
episodes.summary: When Frank loses a tangle with a treadmill, Lucretia's vulnerable side emerges. An ambitious sales promotion at the garage drives Bennie to the brink.

episodes.name: Indy Streets
episodes.summary: Lucretia helps Regina polish her pitch. A shady customer makes Bennie a tempting offer. Bernard's attempt at adulting gets messy.

episodes.name: Cold Shoulder
episodes.summary: Soul food and tough love fuel a family meeting about Kelvin's future. Lucretia gets chilly when Frank would rather hit the slopes than snuggle.

episodes.name: Hole-y Hell
episodes.summary: A busted sports car could be Bennie's ticket out of money trouble. Seeking endorsements, Regina discovers that politics can be a ruthless game.

episodes.name: Great Points
episodes.summary: Bennie and Aaliyah bond over an unlikely sport. Regina and Spencer square off in a debate. Bernard refuses to get kicked to the curb.

episodes.name: Worked Up
episodes.summary: Lucretia isn't thrilled when Bennie puts a mechanic with a past on the payroll. Regina struggles to balance her dreams with her day job.

episodes.name: Election Day
episodes.summary: Regina gets a reality check during a campaign stop at a nursing home. A familiar face stirs up emotions at the gym. Aaliyah receives exciting news.

episodes.name: I Swear
episodes.summary: Family chaos complicates Regina's big day. Bennie faces a turning point for the shop's survival. Bernard and Hector come to Maya's rescue.

episodes.name: Help Less
episodes.summary: A helping hand sparks family friction when Lucretia opens her checkbook one time too many. Bennie's shortcut to success leaves him with a stack of IOUs.

episodes.name: Bon Voyage
episodes.summary: The Upshaws face change with heart and humor as they juggle overdue endings, new beginnings and an ethical dilemma.
